title: Open a submitted email by receipt without listing other submissions
description: An editor with one receipt should be able to review and import its candidate references without fetching the publication monitoring overview. Reuse existing user-pool authorization and candidate controls. Live acceptance remains scoped to the two user-authorized receipts; no new grants or chat changes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Prepared a receipt-only Monitoring entry point using the existing user-pool query and candidate controls; no overview mount, polling, or fallback. Synthetic boundary checks and Gherkin pass; existing monitoring rendering and changed-file lint pass. Live acceptance remains blocked by the current browser session lacking editor/admin claims, and there is no verified native CLI binding for this publication. No receipt reads or imports, model execution, grants, or deployments performed. Release/site pin coordination remains pending; active chat release is untouched.
